learnings: Weekly NDPSR prices follow the CME spot market with a lag: block (weight on same week -0.03, week before 0.21, two weeks before 0.78; typical miss 1.79%); barrel (weight on same week 0.04, week before 0.31, two weeks before 0.63; typical miss 1.35%); butter (weight on same week 0.15, week before 0.51, two weeks before 0.33; typical miss 1.64%); ndm (weight on same week -0.06, week before -0.03, two weeks before 0.98; typical miss 3.48%); whey (weight on same week -0.21, week before -0.02, two weeks before 1.05; typical miss 6.2%). So by the time a week is published, most of it can be predicted from spot prices already seen.
